purpose: Pass 4 native acceptance coverage for the premium Great Lakes map
synchronizationChecks: Every forecast step changes the raster, city temperatures, Match colors, wind frame, and displayed timestamp to the same validAt.
Wind particles move only within the selected exact-hour vector and never imply interpolation to another meteorological frame.
Changing target preserves camera center, zoom, selected forecast hour, time mode, state filter, wind state, and observation state.
Changing Now or Forecast preserves the selected species and layer.
Observed station points appear only in Now and never change city Match colors or ranking data.
visualChecks: Persistent target chip, time tabs, layer tabs, state rail, map tools, attribution, compass, scale, and bottom panel do not overlap.
Animated flow stays legible above every temperature color without obscuring city markers.
Static arrows remain readable with Reduce Motion and when flow is manually disabled.
Small-screen controls remain tappable and all long species, city, station, and disclosure text remains readable or intentionally truncated.
Map retains the FinFindr navy, paper, gold, and freshwater-blue visual language.
Depth remains labeled static and not for navigation; Now remains labeled modeled rather than live.
performanceChecks: No particle animation continues while the screen is unfocused or the app is inactive.
Forecast playback and wind flow can run together without touch or timeline lag.
Repeated target changes do not commit stale condition responses.
Ten minutes of flow animation shows no unbounded memory growth, thermal warning, or crash.
Arrow fallback remains usable on a low-power or reduced-motion device.
releaseBoundary: Evidence is required in Pass 4 before release. This matrix does not authorize deployment.
